CustomField.description: DIR-869: Justification comment captured from the RM/Specialist on the "Submit for Discount Approval" screen flow. Read by the DOA orchestration and written onto the newly-created Approval Work Item's RES_Approval_Request_Remarks__c so the approver sees it; that field is later overwritten with the approver's own decision comment, with the original submission comment preserved via field history.
